set.notes: June has two claim-level candidates. C14-JUN23-001 is Accepted as C14-2023-0002: guest Rabbi Amnon Yitzhak said Mapai was written on trains taking Jews during the Holocaust. Yad Vashem, quoted by The Seventh Eye, says the Hebrew-writing/extermination-train claim is completely false and identifies the cited Mapai-marked train image as displaced persons in 1947 after the war. The entry is explicitly Guest / interviewee, not Channel 14 editorial speech; Channel 14's disavowal/apology and Yitzhak's later objection to the interpretation are preserved. Exact Channel 14 imagery and a guest-hosted replay were recovered; stable GitHub preview C14MED-2023-0002 was built, the canonical Media row updated, Notion published and post-write verified. C14-JUN23-002 preserves Itamar Fleischman's claim that a reported Jerusalem Day attack on a Palestinian was fake as Pending until the exact Channel 14 date/original segment and exact underlying attack are matched. Own-archive/original-media work therefore remains open and no adverse verdict is forced.
